title: 疼痛醫學
intro: 急慢性疼痛的藥物、介入與多專科治療。 本科程序庫由課程工序生成，並標示為模板生成。
introEn: Pharmacological, interventional and multidisciplinary management of acute and chronic pain. This library is generated from the course steps and labelled as template-generated.

procedures.title: 疼痛階梯與多模式止痛
procedures.patient: 依課程「疼痛階梯與多模式止痛」設定的虛擬情境：非鴉片類、輔助藥與鴉片類的合理使用。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Analgesic ladder and multimodal analgesia": Non-opioids, adjuvants and rational opioid use. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

choices.en: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

choices.zh: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
choices.en: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

choices.zh: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
choices.en: Can name at least five complications and their management.

choices.zh: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
choices.en: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

stages.reason: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
stages.reasonEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps. Can name at least five complications and their management.
stages.pitfall: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
stages.pitfallEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.

stages.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
stages.evidence: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
stages.evidenceEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
stages.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
stages.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?

choices.zh: 已正確完成「內側支阻斷診斷與射頻參數」並以文字或數據留下證據。
choices.en: 'Medial-branch block diagnosis and RF parameters' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

choices.zh: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
choices.en: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

choices.zh: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
choices.en: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

choices.zh: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
choices.en: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

stages.reason: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
stages.reasonEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps. The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
stages.pitfall: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
stages.pitfallEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.

stages.title: 結果評估與品質指標
stages.evidence: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
stages.evidenceEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
stages.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
stages.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?

choices.zh: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
choices.en: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

choices.zh: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
choices.en: Can name at least five complications and their management.

choices.zh: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
choices.en: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

choices.zh: 已正確完成「內側支阻斷診斷與射頻參數」並以文字或數據留下證據。
choices.en: 'Medial-branch block diagnosis and RF parameters' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

stages.reason: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
stages.reasonEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps. Can explain at least three quality indicators.
stages.pitfall: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
stages.pitfallEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
